transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, your clinical conversational agent. I can help you with questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous exercise, lifting heavy objects, and swimming for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can continue using any eye drops you were using before your operation, such as for dry eyes, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know. I'm feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, is not normal and may need further assessment. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's reassuring. One last question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for your vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse or blurrier, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything I wanted to ask. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!
